__comment: Phase 16: vase variant 6 (white ceramic). Child of vase_0 geometry; upstream 1.12 shipped the art (block/vases/vase_*_6) but never authored this model. Remaps the parent's numeric keys 0/1/2 onto variant 6 textures - the upstream item jsons tried to remap non-existent 'side'/'top'/'bottom' keys, which is why variants 6+ rendered broken even in 1.12.
